scenario: Receipt total differs from the linked payment amount (scenario-analysis.md #20)

discrepancy.likely_explanation: Tip added at the table, not reflected on the printed receipt.
discrepancy.resolution: Expense.amount is set to payment.amount_inr (2850) — the payment is the source of truth for money actually moved (docs/domain/invariants.md #4). The Receipt record is kept as-is (2700) as evidence of the itemization; the difference is not silently reconciled.
